newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Rashid to withdraw Kwong Yik listing.
newsitem.headline: Rashid to withdraw Kwong Yik listing.

text.p: Rashid Hussain Bhd on Tuesday announced it would withdraw Kwong Yik Bank's listing and increase stake in DCB Holdings Bhd as part of its restructuring plan.

The stockbroking firm said it would increase its stake in 20 percent associate DCB Holdings to 54.17 percent after a restructuring exercise involving itself, DCB Holdings' banking unit DCB Bank Bhd and Kwong Yik.
In a statement, Rashid, which announced it has finalised a deal to acquire 75 percent of Kwong Yik from Malayan Banking Bhd, said Kwong Yik would be merged with DCB Bank.
Rashid said the acquisition of Kwong Yik shares will also result in the merger between DCB Finance Bhd and Kwong Yik Finance Bhd.
The statement said Rashid will pay 2.16 billion ringgit cash to Maybank for the Kwong Yik shares.
The deal would be financed through bank loans and internal funds, it said.

Rashid said the bank loans would be refinanced through issue of shares in Rashid amounting to 10 percent of the equity to Malaysian Resources Corporation Bhd and issue of 2.5 percent secured redeemable bonds to raise 800 million ringgit.
The bond issue will have 54.5 million ringgit attached warrants, the statement said.
MRCB recently announced it would buy a total 20.06 percent of Rashid Hussain's equity.
The Rashid Hussain announcements follow nearly a month of negotiations with Maybank over the price for Kwong Yik.
